reproduced_before: Concurrent eviction during inventory/stat raises FileNotFoundError after successful packet publication.
Pruning tries to unlink a directory and raises PermissionError on this macOS host.
A file replaced between stat and read exceeds the limit yet is returned by load.
change: Reuse existing regular-file metadata snapshot pruning in both planner caches, retaining128 compiled packets and256 search packets.
Read at most LIMIT+1 bytes through one open file; reject oversize bytes independent of earlier path metadata.
Malformed receipt shapes and JSON recursion errors are optional cache misses.
Preserve same-directory temporary publication and require ordinary checker replay for cache hits.

validation.before: 4 new test methods fail with1 failure and6 error reports, including malformed-receipt subcases.
validation.performance: No speed claim; reliability and bounded IO change.

limits: Concurrent cache deletion tests deterministically inject real filesystem removal; not an exhaustive OS interleaving proof.
Selected package checking remains external to the cache loader.
